name: ecological-agent-skills
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'echo "DevContainer ready: R $(R --version | head -1 | grep -oP "\d+\.\d+\.\d+") + Python $(python --version 2>&1 | grep -oP "\d+\.\d+\.\d+")" && Rscript -e "cat(length(.packages(all.available=TRUE)), \"R packages installed\\n\")" && python -c "import pkg_resources; print(len(list(pkg_resources.working_set)), \"Python packages installed\")"'
